perfil: Sparkla's Super Action Pie and Rabbit Pie builds can shift into different modes to counter enemies depending on battlefield conditions.

habilidades.b: Fires energy bullets from her wheelchair-mounted guns, dealing DMG.

tpl.s: Sparkla fires three volleys from her wheelchair-mounted energy guns at the target. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ as Terra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ as Terra Auto Attack DMG.

habilidades.b: Tap to enter ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, firing slow, heavy shots to deal AoE DMG.  Hold to enter ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, firing rapid shots that deal multiple instances of damage. Both modes can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Tap or hold to have Sparkla transform her wheelchair into one of two modes for 10s. ⟦0⟧ Enters ###4033#, lobbing bombs at the target and dealing ⟦1⟧ as Terra Skill DMG. ⟦2⟧ Enters ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, unleashing a rapid stream of shots at the target and dealing ⟦3⟧ as Terra Skill DMG. Both ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ and ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG. Enters cooldown when the transformation ends.

habilidades.b: Sparkla's wheelchair-mounted mechanical arms fire multiple Bunny Fireworks at the target location, dealing damage. Bunny Fireworks can trigger⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Sparkla's wheelchair-mounted mechanical arms fire Bunny Fireworks at the target location, with 2 Bunny Fireworks per volley, 13 volleys in total. The Bunny Fireworks land near the target in random patterns, each dealing ⟦0⟧ as Terra Skill DMG. Bunny Fireworks can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Sparkla takes a nap in her wheelchair and orders her doll to attack nearby targets, dealing AoE DMG. When she wakes up, she deals another wave of AoE DMG at the target's location. This Ultimate can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Sparkla takes a nap in her wheelchair and orders her doll to attack nearby targets, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Terra Ultimate DMG. When she wakes up, she fires a Bunny Firework Cannon at the target location, dealing ⟦1⟧ as AoE Terra Ultimate DMG. This Ultimate can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Terra Mark DMG.

builds.d: A Rabbit Pie build that switches modes to unleash sustained firepower, specializing in taking down single targets.
A Rabbit Pie build that switches modes and unleashes charged bursts, specializing in clearing out groups of enemies.

l.b: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, activates Bunny Rapid Fire to deal damage. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When in an All-Terra squad, increases Bunny Rapid Fire's Skill DMG.
l.s: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, activates Bunny Rapid Fire to unleash a hail of fire on the target, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Terra Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. Bunny Rapid Fire has a Cooldown of 3s. When in an All-Terra squad, increases Bunny Rapid Fire's Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩. When Sparkla deals damage with ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ to a target, inflicts Stellar Crystal. At full stack, the target becomes Stellar Crystallized. Stellar Crystallized target will be stunned and immune to Stellar Crystal. When Sparkla deals damage with ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ to a Stellar Crystallized target, deals additional damage. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ by ⟦0⟧. When Sparkla deals damage with ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ to a target, inflicts 1 stack of Stellar Crystal. At ⟦1⟧ stacks, the target becomes Stellar Crystallized for ⟦2⟧s. Stellar Crystallized target will be ⟦3⟧ and immune to Stellar Crystal. When Sparkla deals damage with ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ to a Stellar Crystallized target, deals an additional ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ allows Sparkla to levitate. She can attack the target while dashing, and her Skill DMG is increased.
l.s: ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩ allows Sparkla to levitate. She can attack the target while dashing, and her Skill DMG is increased by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Sparkla triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩ in ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Sparkla triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩ in ⟨Bunny Rapid Fire Mode⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: Each Sparkla's skill cast increases Sparkla's Skill DMG.
l.s: Each Sparkla's skill cast increases Sparkla's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 7s, up to 10 stacks.

l.b: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, activates Bunny Roar to deal damage. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When channeling Bunny Roar, Sparkla cannot move or dodge. When in an All-Terra squad, Sparkla gains a shield while Bunny Roar is active and increases the Skill DMG of Bunny Roar.
l.s: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, activates Bunny Roar. After a brief charge-up, deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Terra Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When channeling Bunny Roar, Sparkla cannot move or dodge. Sparkla can only cast Bunny Roar once while in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩. When in an All-Terra squad, Sparkla gains a shield equal to ⟦1⟧ of her Base HP while Bunny Roar is active, and increases the Skill DMG of Bunny Jaws Mode by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩. When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains Instant Neo Solution over time. When in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, Sparkla can consume Instant Neo Solution to fire additional shells. When ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ ends, nullifies all Instant Neo Solution.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ by ⟦0⟧. When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains ⟦1⟧ bottle of Instant Neo Solution every 2s. When in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, Sparkla can consume up to ⟦2⟧ bottles of Instant Neo Solution to fire additional shells, each solution can generate ⟦3⟧ shell. When ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ ends, nullifies all Instant Neo Solution.

l.b: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains Super Armor and increases own Skill DMG. After the shells fired in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ explode, Booby Traps are randomly deployed within the blast radius. The traps can deal damage and trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains Super Armor and increases own Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. After the shells fired in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩ explode, 5 Booby Traps are randomly deployed within the blast radius, each Booby Trap dealing ⟦1⟧ as Terra Skill DMG. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. Shells fired by Bunny Roar scatter 10 Booby Traps over a much larger area.

l.b: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, each shot deals damage to enemies in front and knocks them back. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: When Sparkla is in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, each shot deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Terra Skill DMG to enemies in front and knocks them back. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩. When casting Bunny Roar, each shot deals ⟦1⟧ as AoE Terra Skill DMG to enemies in front and knocks them back. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: When Sparkla enters ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains a shield. When Sparkla remains stationary in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Sparkla enters ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of her Base HP for 10s. When Sparkla remains stationary in ⟨Bunny Jaws Mode⟩, increases her ATK by ⟦1⟧ every 1s for a total of 5s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: When Sparkla casts the Main Skill to transform, increases her ATK. When the transformation ends, deals DMG to nearby targets. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.
l.s: When Sparkla casts the Main Skill to transform, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 12s. When the transformation ends, deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG to up to 6 nearby targets. Can trigger ⟨Terra Mark⟩.

l.b: Increases Sparkla's Terra DMG to distant targets.
l.s: Increases Sparkla's Terra DMG to distant targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Sparkla can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases Sparkla's ATK.
l.s: Sparkla can dodge one more time. After dodging, increases Sparkla's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s. This effect can only be triggered once every 10s.

l.b: When the Ultimate ends, drops bottles of Potent Neo Solution on the ground. When the Main Trekker absorbs them, increases their ATK. When a Terra Trekker absorbs 3 bottles of Potent Neo Solution and deals Auto Attack DMG, Sparkla deals additional DMG.
l.s: When All-Out Bunny Barrage (Ultimate) ends, drops 3 bottles of Potent Neo Solution on the ground. The Main Trekker can absorb them on contact, with each bottle increasing their ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s. When a Terra Trekker absorbs 3 bottles of Potent Neo Solution and deals Auto Attack DMG, Sparkla deals an additional ⟦1⟧ of her ATK as Terra Ultimate DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 0.5s.

l.b: Increases the Attack Range of the Bunny Firework Cannon fired by the Ultimate. Instantly eliminates normal targets within range and deals damage to elite and boss targets over time.
l.s: Increases the Attack Range of the Bunny Firework Cannon fired by All-Out Bunny Barrage (Ultimate). Instantly eliminates normal targets within range, and inflicts Bleeding on elite and boss targets. Deals DMG to the target once per second for 10s, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Terra Mark Ultimate DMG in total.

l.b: When the Ultimate triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩, increases the Ultimate DMG of this Ultimate.
l.s: When All-Out Bunny Barrage (Ultimate) triggers ⟨Terra Mark⟩, increases the Ultimate DMG of this Ultimate by ⟦0⟧,  stacking up to 7 times.

builds.d: A Super Action Pie build focused on enhanced burst power, dealing massive damage in a short window.
A Super Action Pie build focused on endurance, allowing you to coordinate with squadmates for a relentless assault on enemies.

l.b: When casting the Bunny Firework, Sparkla gains Energy each time a rocket is fired. When the Support Skill ends, Sparkla consumes all Energy to increase her Skill DMG. She then charges toward the target in her wheelchair, dealing damage.
l.s: When casting Homing Bunny Volley (Support Skill), Sparkla gains Energy each time a Bunny Firework is fired. When the Support Skill ends, Sparkla consumes all Energy, with each point increasing her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s. She then charges toward the target in her chair, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG and inflicting Bleeding, which deals DMG to the target once every 0.3s for 3s, dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Terra Skill DMG in total.

l.s: When Sparkla casts Homing Bunny Volley (Support Skill), deals ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Terra Skill DMG to nearby targets.
